title: Witch in Arcane Study
description: A green-haired witch in purple and gold robes sits at a red table inside a mystical chamber. She holds a glowing blue orb in her right hand while studying an open spellbook, surrounded by potion jars, magical herbs, coins, a lit red candle, and framed arcane artwork.
prompt: A beautiful witch with long green braided hair and golden accessories sits at a red wooden table inside a purple stone chamber. She holds a glowing blue orb while reading an open spellbook. The scene includes potion jars on red shelves, magical herbs, a lit red candle dripping wax, gold coins, and a framed painting of another witch. An arched window shows glowing runes. Vibrant fantasy illustration style with rich colors and magical atmosphere.
